## Data Model Signals

This screen reveals the following entities and fields:

### Person (Contact) Entity
- `id` — unique identifier (in URL when clicking through)
- `name` / `fullName` — string (supports both person names and entity names like "Schiemer Living Trust", "Charisse Toney Living Trust")
- `avatarUrl` or `initials` — for the circular photo in the Name column
- `stage` / `type` — enum tag value (observed values: `"Expired Listing"`, `"Farm"`; likely also `"Active"`, `"Pending"`, `"Client"`, `"Lead"`, etc.)
- `leadScore` — integer 1–5
- `assignedAgent` — foreign key to User/Agent entity
- `lastVisit` — datetime (date of last tracked website visit)
- `phone` — string (E.164 format stored, displayed as `(NXX) NXX-XXXX`)
- `hasWhatsApp` — boolean (green WhatsApp icon indicates WhatsApp availability on the number)
- `email` — string
- `lastActivity` — datetime + text description (derived from most recent timeline event)
- `lastActivityDescription` — string (e.g., "Viewed Central Oregon Real Estate Experts in Bend")
- `smartListMemberships` — many-to-many with SmartList

### SmartList Entity
- `id` — unique identifier
- `name` — string (e.g., "All Expireds", "Absentee Owners", "ColdBi-Monthly")
- `count` — integer (cached contact count)
- `type` — enum (`"collection"` vs `"smart_list"` — FUB distinguishes Collections from Smart Lists in the UI)
- `isSystem` — boolean (some lists appear system-generated like "All Recent Online Activity")
- `filters` — JSON criteria for dynamic membership

### User/Agent Entity
- `id`
- `name` (e.g., "Matt")
- `email` (e.g., matt@ryan-realty.com)
- `avatarUrl`
- `title` (e.g., "Owner & Principal Broker")
- `brokerage` (e.g., "Ryan Realty LLC")
- `phone` (e.g., 541.703.3095)
- `website` (e.g., ryan-realty.com)
- `emailSignatureHtml` — rich HTML signature block

### Email/Activity Entity (implied by compose panel and Last Activity column)
- `personId` — FK to Person
- `type` — enum (`"email_sent"`, `"page_view"`, `"call"`, `"text"`, `"note"`, etc.)
- `description` — string (the truncated "Viewed..." text)
- `occurredAt` — datetime

### Neighborhood Entity
- `name`
- `count` — 125 contacts associated

### Enum Values Observed
- **Stage/Type tags:** `Expired Listing`, `Farm` (likely also `Active`, `Pending Client`, `Past Client`, `Lead`, `Buyer`, `Seller`, etc.)
- **Lead Score:** integer scale 1–5
- **Sort options:** `lastLeadActivity` (observed in URL; likely also `name`, `lastVisit`, `leadScore`, `dateAdded`, `stage`)

```
      <SmartListItem label="FSBO" badge={15} />
      <SmartListItem label="TC/Logistics — Hard Stop" badge={135} />
      <ManageSmartListsLink label="Manage" />
    </LeftRail>

    <MainContent>
      <PageHeader>
        <PageTitle>All People</PageTitle>
        <RecordCount>Showing 874 people</RecordCount>
        <ViewToggle options={["list", "table", "grid"]} active="table" />
        <HelpLink label="How Smart Lists work" icon="question" />
        <ColumnsDropdownButton label="Columns" />
        <ActiveFilterChip label="Out Of State H..." />  {/* or smart list chip */}
      </PageHeader>

      <PeopleTable
        sort={{ field: "lastActivity", direction: "desc" }}
        columns={[
          { key: "name", label: "Name" },
          { key: "leadScore", label: "Lead Score" },
          { key: "agent", label: "Agent" },
          { key: "lastVisit", label: "Last Visit" },
          { key: "phone", label: "Phone" },
          { key: "email", label: "Email" },
          { key: "lastActivity", label: "Last Activity", sortActive: true, sortDir: "desc" },
        ]}
      >
        {people.map(person => (
          <PeopleTableRow key={person.id} person={person}>
            <NameCell>
              <Avatar src={person.avatarUrl} initials={person.initials} />
              <ContactName>{person.name}</ContactName>
              {person.stageTag && <StagePill label={person.stageTag} />}
            </NameCell>
            <LeadScoreCell score={person.leadScore} />
            <AgentCell agent={person.assignedAgent} />
            <LastVisitCell date={person.lastVisit} />
            <PhoneCell phone={person.phone} hasWhatsApp={person.hasWhatsApp} />
            <EmailCell email={person.email} />
            <LastActivityCell description={person.lastActivityDescription} />
          </PeopleTableRow>
        ))}
      </PeopleTable>
    </MainContent>

    <FilterSidebar>
      <AddFilterButton label="Add a filter" />
      <EmptyState message="No filters added yet" />
    </FilterSidebar>
  </AppBody>

  {/* Floating overlays */}
  <EmailComposePanel isOpen={true}>
    <ComposeHeader title="New Email" onClose={...} />
    <ToField value="" placeholder="To" />
    <CcBccToggle label="CC BCC >" />
    <SubjectField value="" placeholder="Subject" />
    <RichTextToolbar>
      <ToolbarButton icon="bold" />
      <ToolbarButton icon="italic" />
      <ToolbarButton icon="underline" />
      <ToolbarButton icon="strikethrough" />
      <ToolbarButton icon="link" />
      <ToolbarButton icon="image" />
      <ToolbarButton icon="list" />
      {/* additional formatting buttons */}
    </RichTextToolbar>
    <EmailBodyEditor
      defaultContent={<EmailSignature agent={currentUser} />}
    />
    <ComposeFooter>
      <AttachmentsButton label="Attachments" />
      <TemplatesButton label="Templates" />
      <SendButton label="Send Email" variant="primary" />
    </ComposeFooter>
  </EmailComposePanel>
</FUBApp>
```

### Non-Obvious Logic

1. **Sort parameter in URL:** The table sort is encoded directly in the URL (`?sort=lastLeadActivity`). Changing sort updates the URL and reloads the list. This allows deep-linking to a specific sort state.

2. **"Showing 874 people" count:** This is the total across ALL people regardless of scroll position. The count updates when filters are applied.

3. **Stage/type tags in the Name cell:** Not all contacts have a visible tag — the tag is optional and only shows when set (e.g., "Expired Listing", "Farm"). Tags likely map to the FUB "Stage" or "Type" field, shown inline in the name column rather than a separate column.

4. **Lead Score (1–5):** This is FUB's built-in engagement/activity scoring system. Score increases automatically based on website visits, email opens, replies, call activity, etc. Score of 5 = hottest lead.

5. **WhatsApp integration:** The green WhatsApp icon next to phone numbers is an active integration — clicking it opens a WhatsApp conversation thread, likely via WhatsApp Business API. Only appears when WhatsApp is detected as available for that number.

6. **Last Activity truncation:** The "Last Activity" column shows webpage view events sourced from FUB's website tracking pixel/script. The text "Viewed Central Oregon Real Estate Experts in B..." is a page title from the tracked website. Full text would be "Viewed Central Oregon Real Estate Experts in Bend" or similar. The truncation is controlled by column width.

7. **Email Compose pre-loaded signature:** The compose panel automatically inserts the logged-in agent's email signature when opened. The signature is formatted in HTML and includes headshot image, contact info, links, and legal disclosures.

8. **"Out Of State H..." filter chip:** This appears to be a pre-applied smart list or filter labeled something like "Out Of State Homebuyers" — it's rendered as a small chip/button in the toolbar area, suggesting it's a current context filter or a quick-access filter toggle that is active.

9. **Collections vs Smart Lists distinction:** FUB separates "COLLECTIONS" (agent-curated groups, possibly manual or semi-automated) from "SMART LISTS" (fully rule-based dynamic lists). Both appear in the left rail under different section headers with the same visual treatment but conceptually different editing interfaces.

10. **"TC/Logistics — Hard Stop" smart list (count: 135):** A custom smart list used by Ryan Realty to tag contacts who should NOT receive automated texts (TCPA compliance / litigator list). The name uses an em-dash. This demonstrates FUB's support for compliance-gating via smart lists.

11. **Contact record types:** FUB supports non-individual contact names ("Schiemer Living Trust", "Charisse Toney Living Trust") — trust entities and company names are stored alongside personal names in the same contacts table with the same data model.

12. **Agent attribution column:** The "Agent" column shows which FUB user is the assigned agent for each contact. Multiple agents can exist in the same FUB account (brokerage-wide CRM), and each contact is assigned to one primary agent.
